objective_summary: Independently harden the deterministic NYG cap-roster engine and the NFL answer guardrails against numeric, citation, provenance, and private-input errors.

nodes.goal: Review and harden the existing deterministic cap-roster engine. Preserve the public API. Add or fix focused fixtures for negative economics, one action per player, exact branch reconciliation, protected players/groups, source-needed exclusion, stale/fallback readiness, missing locators, impossible targets, and user-entered assumptions. Do not touch routes or shared types. Return codex_task_worker_result.v1.
nodes.expected_output: A minimal reviewed patch to the deterministic engine and its focused fixture suite, or an explicit no-change result with evidence.
nodes.verification: Run the focused nfl_decision test and server typecheck. Demonstrate every invariant from the goal in test assertions.
nodes.stop_condition: Stop rather than allowing estimated/source-needed rows to drive exact recommendations or weakening any fail-closed guard.

nodes.goal: Harden the NFL composer/private critic so an LLM may explain a validated deterministic cap-roster payload but cannot originate, repair, or alter integer dollar figures, branch totals, rule citations, or private inputs. Add focused adversarial tests and deterministic-summary fallback behavior without importing NBA concepts. Return codex_task_worker_result.v1.
nodes.expected_output: Branch-aware prompt contracts, deterministic-number/citation enforcement, abstention behavior, and adversarial fixtures.
nodes.verification: Run the two focused test files and server typecheck; show that numeric/citation drift is rejected and deterministic fallback remains renderable.
nodes.stop_condition: After two same-scope attempts, stop on unsupported output rather than relaxing the critic or inventing private team inputs.
